The command in section 1 (establishes the National Agricultural Advisory Commission of eighteen members with terms and a President-designated chairman) therefore ended on 1965-11-04 by presidential express revocation. research_rationale:
EO 10472 (18 FR 4247, July 20, 1953; held official Federal Register text) established the National Agricultural Advisory Commission to advise the Secretary of Agriculture, with its membership and terms (section 1), its advisory duty and meetings (section 2) and a no-funds-pending-appropriation rule (section 3). EO 10937 of May 3, 1961 restated section 1 (an amendment, not an end; its Federal Register copy is held only as a custody record, so it is disclosed here but not cited as a source). EO 11256 of November 4, 1965 (30 FR 14137) revoked EO 10472 and EO 10937 in its section 7 and established a new Committee and Commission in the same order. Every clause therefore ended on 1965-11-04 and the order was not in force on 2026-10-14. The inventory is corrected because the machine span missed section 1 and the first part of section 2 (columns misordered in the held scan).
